conventions.date_mode: with timestamp_iso: one flat record per point for that date; without: 12 records (15th of each month)
conventions.measured: true = orbital map read at this point (LOLA, Diviner, Lunar Prospector, LROC) or exact ephemeris; false = model prediction (regolith heat model, thermal inertia from rock abundance, polar night estimate); null = no data
conventions.base_suitability: 0-100, weighted mean of power, water, communication, terrain, thermal, ISRU oxygen and shelter scores (each 0-1); priority: a permanent base, not only a landing
conventions.sunlight: sun/earth visibility fractions are 18.6-year averages including terrain shadows (LOLA, poleward of 65 deg); elsewhere flat horizon (sun 50%)
conventions.target_profile: team spec Component 3 features with spec units (temp_mean in deg C); dust_aerosol and radiation_proxy are 0 (no atmosphere: column mass 0 g/cm2); soil_moisture null (no defensible orbital value)

best_nearby.note: published point kept as the site; this is the best-lit flat spot within the radius (sun and Earth visibility fractions, slope in deg)

weights.rationale: feature weights: importance of each spec feature when matching Earth analogs for a Moon base; base weights: importance of each component in the base-suitability score (power, water, communication, terrain, thermal, ISRU oxygen, shelter)

surface_roughness.source: LOLA, local relief: std of detrended elevation over ~13 km (same definition as Mars)

lola_roughness.source: LOLA roughness product (small scale), where LOLA has data

sun_visibility_fraction.source: LOLA average illumination over 18.6 years, 240 m pixel (Mazarico et al. 2011)

sun_visibility_best_within_1km.source: best pixel within 1 km (where a mast or panel could stand)

earth_visibility_fraction.source: LOLA average Earth visibility over 18.6 years, 240 m pixel (Mazarico et al. 2011)

nearest_cold_trap_km.source: nearest permanently shadowed pixel within 15 km (LOLA illumination)

ice_depth.unit: m (depth below which water ice is stable)
ice_depth.source: Diviner polar resource product (-1 code read as surface-stable)

ice_within_1m_fraction.source: Diviner polar resource product, 1.5 km neighbourhood

nearest_ice_stable_ground_km.source: nearest 500 m cell with ice stable within 1 m in half its area (Diviner), within 15 km

thermal_inertia.source: regolith 55 (Hayne et al. 2017) blended with rock 2200 by Diviner rock abundance (no rock data: regolith only)

nearest_skylight_km.source: LROC Lunar Pit Atlas: Schomberger A 1 (Impact Melt pit)

atmosphere.source: vacuum: no shielding, no weather, no dust storms

solar_elevation_max.source: noon sun on this date, flat horizon

surface_temp_min.source: min(flat model night, Diviner annual mean)

surface_temp_max.source: Diviner annual maximum

surface_temp_mean.source: Diviner annual mean (2 cm depth)

surface_temp_amplitude.source: Diviner max - estimated min
